description: A thin impervious sheet, such as celluloid, laid between the damp cover and the leaves so moisture from pasting cannot cockle the paper while the binding sets.
name: waterproof sheet

source_ref.label: Douglas Cockerell, Bookbinding and the Care of Books (1902), Chapter XII, p.162. Internet Archive.
